summary.zh: 每多打一刀，都在花掉下一次闪避的余量。
summary.en: Every extra attack spends part of your escape budget.

rules.zh: 攻击、翻滚和受击格挡消耗同一资源；停止消耗后恢复。玩家既要打出伤害，也要为敌人的下一轮反击留下行动额度，耐力条直接暴露透支风险。
rules.en: Attacks, rolls and blocked hits draw from one regenerating pool. Deal damage while reserving enough for the next enemy response; the stamina bar makes overcommitment visible.

decisions.zh: 追击残血还是保留翻滚？击杀收益与被反打风险直接冲突。
decisions.en: Finish a weakened enemy or save a roll? A quick kill competes with surviving the reply.

decisions.zh: 举盾安全但恢复较慢时，何时放下盾成为主动决策。
decisions.en: When raised guarding slows recovery, lowering the shield becomes an active choice.

effect.zh: 延迟越长，连续贪刀后的空窗越危险。
effect.en: Longer delays create a more vulnerable pause after overattacking.

effect.zh: 重击成本高，玩家更重视命中把握和敌人的硬直。
effect.en: Expensive heavy attacks make certainty and enemy recovery more valuable.

contrast.zh: 两者都限制连续进攻；《艾尔登法环》明确放宽非战斗移动成本，降低赶路负担。
contrast.en: Both constrain sustained aggression; Elden Ring explicitly relaxes the cost outside combat to reduce travel friction.

combination.zh: 设计提案：把重型采矿工具也接入耐力预算，遭遇敌人时可选择放弃挖掘以保留防御余量。
combination.en: Design proposal: let heavy mining tools spend combat stamina, making a surprise encounter a choice between one last extraction and a safe defense.

setup.zh: 你有 60 点耐力，攻击花 20，翻滚花 25。
setup.en: You have 60 stamina; an attack costs 20 and a roll costs 25.

action.zh: 敌人刚收招，你砍一刀后停手，留下 40 点。
action.en: After the enemy finishes a swing, attack once and keep 40 stamina.

result.zh: 敌人反击时，你仍能翻滚；如果砍两刀就只剩 20。
result.en: You can roll away from its reply; two attacks would have left only 20.

next.zh: 退开恢复，再判断下次空当能安全打几刀。
next.en: Back off to recover, then judge how many hits the next opening allows.

firstStep.zh: 做一个固定节奏敌人、攻击和翻滚两个按钮，以及会恢复的耐力条。
firstStep.en: Build one enemy with a fixed rhythm, attack and roll buttons, and a regenerating stamina bar.

pitfall.zh: 先别加武器库；动作成本与敌人节奏没配好，更多武器只会放大问题。
pitfall.en: Avoid a weapon catalogue until action costs work with the enemy rhythm.

test.zh: 观察玩家是否会在耐力没空时主动停手，并能说出保留耐力的原因。
test.en: Watch whether players stop before exhaustion and can explain what they are saving stamina for.
